profile.certificationsSubtitle: Granted by completed sessions or earned outside
profile.budgetSubtitle: The year's balance, what is still available, and every entry

courses.description: The course catalogue: what each course teaches, who gives it and how, and the certification completing it grants.
courses.codeHint: Letters, digits, dashes and underscores; unique.
courses.title: Title
courses.certificationHint: Leave empty if completing the course does not certify. With a name, everyone who completes a session receives it.

problems.code: Enter a code of letters, digits, dashes or underscores (up to 32).
problems.currency: Choose the currency of the cost.

sessions.description: Every training session with its seats taken. Open a session to enroll employees, complete it or cancel it.
sessions.selfEnrollmentHint: They see it under My training until the first day, while seats remain.
sessions.cancelConfirm: The session and its {n} active enrollments will be cancelled, and those enrolled will be told. This cannot be undone.

problems.dates: Choose the first and last day.
problems.order: The last day cannot be before the first.

enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.cancelConfirm: Cancel {name}'s enrollment? Their seat is freed.

enroll.title: Enroll employees
enroll.hint: Each one is told. If any one cannot be enrolled, nobody is, and the reason is shown.

complete.title: Complete session
complete.hint: Everyone still enrolled completes on the last day, except those marked as not attending. A score out of 100 is optional.
complete.hintCertifies: Everyone still enrolled completes on the last day, except those marked as not attending, and receives the course's certification. A score out of 100 is optional.
complete.nobody: Nobody is enrolled; the session will simply be marked completed.
complete.afterEnd: Available once the session's last day has come.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Every certification on file. Filter by expiry to see what needs renewing.
certifications.addHint: One earned outside. Its expiry, if any, will appear in the HR alerts.
certifications.pickEmployee: Choose an employee to record a certification for them.
certifications.name: Certification

problems.order: The expiry cannot be before the issue date.

budgets.title: Learning budget
budgets.description: Each employee's learning budget for a year. Open a row for its ledger and to adjust it.
budgets.empty: No budget has been allocated for {year}.
budgets.availableHint: The balance less requests awaiting approval
budgets.allocateHint: Gives the same amount for the year to everyone employed today, or to the employees you choose.
budgets.skipHint: Anyone already allocated for that year is skipped, so nobody receives it twice.
budgets.adjustHint: Adds to or takes from the {year} budget. The note stays on the ledger.

problems.nonZero: Enter an amount other than zero.
problems.note: Write the reason for the adjustment.

requests.courseHint: Optional: one of the courses in your sessions. Leave it empty for learning outside.
requests.title: Spending requests
requests.decidedWhere: Requests are approved or rejected in the approvals inbox; the final approval checks the balance again.
requests.whatPlaceholder: For example: a barista course at Coffee Lab
requests.yearHint: Draws on the budget of the year it starts in; without a date, this year's.
requests.addHint: Ask to spend your learning budget on learning outside. It goes for approval.
requests.sent: The request has been sent for approval.

mine.description: Sessions you can enroll in, your enrollments and certifications, and your learning budget.
mine.noOpen: No sessions are open for enrollment right now.
mine.noEnrollments: You have not enrolled in any session.
mine.cancelConfirm: Cancel your enrollment in {course}? Your seat is freed.
